alerts_ack_hint: Reminders pause; you are still told when it resolves. Enter = {hours} h.
alerts_form_description: Mute alerts for a device, or all of them, for a window.
alerts_form_device_help: Leave empty to cover every device.
alerts_form_error_daily: Enter the daily start and end as HH:MM.
alerts_form_error_daily_differ: The daily start and end must differ.
alerts_form_error_dates: Enter a valid start and end.
alerts_form_error_days: Pick at least one day of the week.
alerts_form_error_month_days: Enter the days of the month as numbers from 1 to 31, for example “1, 15”.
alerts_form_error_name: Give the window a name — it explains, later, why these alerts went quiet.
alerts_form_error_order: The end of the window must come after its start.
alerts_form_for_help: Real elapsed time: a 2 h window lasts 2 h, even on a clock-change night.
alerts_form_local_time_help: Local time in the zone below.
alerts_form_month_days_help: One or more, from 1 to 31, separated by commas. A month without that day is skipped.
alerts_form_name_help: Shown in the list and in history.
alerts_form_timezone_help: An IANA name such as Europe/Paris. The window keeps its local hour across daylight-saving changes.
alerts_form_which_help: A month without that one — no fifth Sunday — is skipped.
alerts_history_empty_description: Alert transitions appear here as rules start firing and resolving.
alerts_history_error_clear_all: Could not clear the resolved entries.
alerts_history_error_cleared: Could not load the cleared entries.
alerts_history_everything: That is everything from the last {days} days.
alerts_history_nomatch_description: Widen the filters to see the log again.
alerts_ignore_error: Could not ignore this rule for this device.
alerts_ignore_error_undo: Could not stop ignoring this rule.
alerts_needs_dismissed_hint: Known problems: reminders are paused until the acknowledgement ends or the alert resolves.
alerts_needs_quiet_all_reporting: Every device is reporting and no rule is firing.
alerts_needs_quiet_no_devices: Add a device and its first report shows up here.

match.countPlural=one: No rule is firing. One device is still waiting for a first report.
match.countPlural=other: No rule is firing. {count} devices are still waiting for a first report.

alerts_needs_quiet_waiting_one: No rule is firing. One device is still waiting for a first report.
alerts_needs_snoozed_hint: Hidden for a while: no reminder until the window ends or the alert resolves.
alerts_over_error_clear_number: The clear threshold must be a number.
alerts_over_error_empty: Set a threshold, a clear threshold, or turn the rule off for this device.
alerts_over_none: None. Overrides change the threshold, the clear threshold, or turn this rule off for one device.
alerts_over_turn_off: Turn this rule off for the device
alerts_page_description: What is firing now, what is scheduled to stay quiet, the rules behind it, and where you are told.
alerts_page_error_refresh_windows: Could not refresh the maintenance windows.
alerts_page_error_remove_window: Could not remove the maintenance window.
alerts_row_acked: Acked{by}{until}{note}. Reminders paused; you will still hear when it resolves.
alerts_row_learning: Silent for its first {days} days of baseline.
alerts_row_learning_suppressed: Silent while it learns the normal shape.
alerts_row_snoozed: Snoozed{until}. Quiet until then, or until it resolves.
alerts_row_suppressed_by: Suppressed by {parent} — probably a consequence, not a separate problem.
alerts_rules_anomaly_summary: sensitivity k = {k} · smoothing α = {alpha} · minimum {samples} samples · floor {abs} abs / {rel} rel
alerts_rules_edit_all_none: All enabled channels — none is enabled right now, so nothing is sent
alerts_rules_edit_channels_error: Could not load the channels ({error}). Leaving the list as it is: {state}
alerts_rules_edit_clear_help: Optional. Once firing, the alert only clears past this value, so a reading hovering at the threshold does not flap.
alerts_rules_edit_detection_help: Baseline anomaly settings are shipped with the rule and not editable here.
alerts_rules_edit_error_clear_above: The clear threshold must be above the threshold: fire below one, clear over the other.
alerts_rules_edit_error_clear_below: The clear threshold must be below the threshold: fire above one, clear under the other.
alerts_rules_edit_error_clear_number: The clear threshold must be a number, or left empty.
alerts_rules_edit_error_query: The query is required — without it the rule watches nothing.
alerts_rules_edit_escalate_help: Raise the severity one rung if still firing.
alerts_rules_edit_hold_anomaly_help: How long the anomaly must last before firing.
alerts_rules_edit_hold_help: How long the condition must last before firing.
alerts_rules_edit_no_channel: No channel yet — nothing is sent. {link}.
alerts_rules_edit_only_ticked: Only the ticked channels are notified.
alerts_rules_empty_description: Add a rule to start watching a metric, or wait for the shipped rules to appear.
alerts_rules_error_hold: Hold time must be a whole number of seconds.
alerts_rules_error_query: The MetricsQL query is required — without it the rule watches nothing.
alerts_rules_error_threshold: The threshold must be a number.
alerts_rules_hold_for_help: Seconds the condition must last before firing.
alerts_rules_new_description: A threshold rule watching one MetricsQL query. Channels and reminders can be tuned once it exists.
alerts_rules_nomatch_description: Try a different search term or kind.
alerts_rules_search_placeholder: Search by name, description or query
alerts_silences_empty_description: Schedule a window to mute a device — or all of them — while you work on it.
alerts_snooze_hint: No notification until it ends or the alert resolves.
notifications_channels_description: Where DumbMonit tells you when something needs attention.
notifications_channels_empty_admin: Add Discord, Telegram, email or one of 20 others to get alerts where you already are.
notifications_channels_empty_viewer: An admin can add Discord, Telegram, email or one of 20 others.
notifications_channels_policy_interval: same alert every {minutes} min at most
notifications_form_clear_secrets_help: Removes what is stored; the channel will fail until new secrets are entered.
notifications_form_delivery_hint: — what this channel hears, and when
notifications_form_enabled_help: A disabled channel keeps its setup but receives nothing.
notifications_form_error_json: Must be a valid JSON object, for example "key": "value".
notifications_form_error_json_object: Must be a JSON object, not a list or a plain value.
notifications_form_error_name: Give the channel a name; you will pick it in alert rules.
notifications_form_interval: Same alert again no sooner than
notifications_form_interval_help: Reminders and re-fires of one alert are spaced out by at least this.
notifications_form_name_help: Shown in the channel list and picked in alert rules.
notifications_form_pick_hint: Pick a service. Only the fields it needs come next.
notifications_form_resolved_help: Off: the channel only hears about problems, never recoveries.
notifications_form_secrets_destination_c: The destination changed: enter the secrets again, saved ones are not sent to a new address.
notifications_form_secrets_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
notifications_form_secrets_note: Encrypted at rest and never shown again.
notifications_form_secrets_saved: A secret is already saved for this channel.
notifications_form_send_help: Alerts below this level never reach the channel.
notifications_matcher_help: Off: the channel receives everything above its severity floor. On: only what matches, by tag, device kind or rule.
notifications_matcher_none: No device matches today — this channel would stay silent.
notifications_matcher_rules_note: Rule conditions apply to alerts, not devices: the count above ignores them.
notifications_policy_also_tell_help: One extra hop, sent once. Its own severity floor and quiet hours do not hold it back.
notifications_policy_cap_help: Past the cap, alerts wait and arrive as one digest. Empty: no cap.
notifications_policy_description: How DumbMonit keeps notifications few: one message per burst, a cap per hour, and silence for alerts that flap.
notifications_policy_error_cap: The hourly cap must be a whole number, or empty for no cap.
notifications_policy_error_escalate: Pick the channel to tell when nobody acknowledges, or set the delay to “Never escalate”.
notifications_policy_error_flap: Flap detection needs at least 2 state changes.
notifications_policy_error_load: Could not load the notification policy
notifications_policy_error_url: The public URL must start with http:// or https://.
notifications_policy_escalate_help: Counted from the moment the first message actually goes out, not from the alert firing.
notifications_policy_escalate_off: Nobody is told twice: an alert nobody acknowledges keeps to its own channels.
notifications_policy_escalate_on: If nobody acknowledges within {minutes} min of the first message going out, the alert is also sent to {name} — once. Acknowledging it, or its clearing, stops the hop.
notifications_policy_flap_help: An alert that fires and clears repeatedly sends one “flapping” notice, then stays silent for a while.
notifications_policy_group_help: Alerts that fire within this window leave as one message per channel: “3 alerts on 2 devices”.
notifications_policy_per_channel_note: What each channel hears, and its quiet hours, are set on the channel itself (Edit, then “Delivery options”).
notifications_policy_url_help: Used for the “Open in DumbMonit” link in every message. Leave empty to use DUMBMONIT_PUBLIC_URL.
notifications_quiet_error_differ: The start and end must differ.
notifications_quiet_error_format: Enter the start and end as HH:MM.
notifications_quiet_from_help: Your local time. A span past midnight belongs to the day it starts on.
notifications_quiet_help: Only Warning-level alerts come through during quiet hours; the rest waits and arrives as one digest when they end.

overview_tip_agent_text: Services, disk health, temperatures, updates waiting, Docker containers you can restart or update from here, Plakar, restic and Borg backups. One command on Linux, Windows, macOS or FreeBSD.
overview_tip_agent_title: The agent sees inside a machine.
overview_tip_api_text: A scoped token (read, or read and write) opens it to your scripts, and a Prometheus or Grafana you already run can read the measurements with the same token.
overview_tip_api_title: Everything here has an HTTP API.
overview_tip_mcp_text: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can ask DumbMonit how things are — and, with a write token, silence a device or run a probe.
overview_tip_mcp_title: An AI assistant can read this bulletin.
overview_tip_packs_text: An integration pack is a device type written in YAML: what to ask the device, which numbers to keep, when to alert.
overview_tip_packs_title: DumbMonit can learn a new device.
overview_tip_palette_text: The command palette jumps to any device, page or action without leaving the keyboard.
overview_tip_palette_title: Every page and action is one shortcut away.
overview_tip_relay_text: Put one on a machine at a second site, a client’s office or behind a NAT: it probes the switches, NAS and hypervisors there for this server. Outbound only — nothing to open on that side.
overview_tip_relay_title: An agent can watch another network.
overview_tip_status_text: A public status page shows the services you pick, their uptime and your announcements — a link to share instead of answering “is it down?”.
overview_tip_wall_text: Wall mode shows the sky and what needs you, full screen and readable across the room, and keeps the screen awake.
overview_week_quiet: A quiet week ahead: no certificate, disk or maintenance due.
